execution.mechanism: klt sim --backend batch (2am EDA batch fleet, Spot)
execution.timing_note: elapsed_s per corner is the remote engine wall clock reported by klt (runtime_s). job_elapsed_s is the fleet harness's own job time. queue_provision_and_transfer_s = submit-to-collect wall minus job_elapsed_s (S3 upload, Spot acquisition/boot, polling granularity, download).

experiment.claim: spec/topology-survey.md Startup row ("self-starting, < 1 ms") -- the startup-TIME half. Measures, in a single transient per PVT point, how long design/bandgap_core.sch + design/startup_injector.sch takes to bring VOUT up after the supply arrives, on a slow ramp, on a fast ramp, and from the worst case of all: placed *in* the degenerate zero-current state at full supply and asked to leave it. The no-other-stable-state half of the same spec line is the sibling experiment sim/startup-stability/; the +/-1% output-accuracy claim is issue #11.
experiment.statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix claim, not a distribution claim)
experiment.title: Startup: supply-ramp transient startup time against the < 1 ms spec line

spread_checks.note: Untrimmed output over process and temperature must move by more than 10 mV; a frozen value would indicate the .lib corner or .temp injection stopped taking effect.
